article.title: The ‘blue wave’ is a defeat for Israel, but the left’s work is just beginning
article.author: Michael Arria
article.content: Political consultant Peter Feld says the midterms were a rebuke of Trump, the Iran war, and Israel. But with AIPAC adapting and J Street rising, he warns progressives must push for a full arms embargo and resist the capture of their new champions.
